proposal.rationale: Speed up the two hot helpers in minbpe/base.py used by both training and encoding. get_stats now counts pairs with collections' C helper _count_elements (it does exactly counts[pair] = counts.get(pair, 0) + 1 in iteration order, so insertion order and tie-breaking stay the same; there is a pure-Python fallback). merge uses list.count/list.index to jump to occurrences of pair[0] in C and copies the runs between them as slices, with a fast path when pair[0] is absent. The scan is the same left-to-right, non-overlapping replacement, including the p0 == p1 case. Equivalence outputs are identical. Measured train_ir 0.815x and encode_ir 0.823x.
